workouts.name: Phase 1 Wk1 Day1 SR
workouts.description: Complete this workout first, then rest 10-15mins and move on to Aerobic Power Interval workout on Kilterboard

exercises.name: Elevated Hip Thrust
exercises.tips: Place Barbell over hips

exercises.name: 90/90 ER Iso
exercises.tips: Alternate side each rep. Needs to be heavy ~8.5/10 RPE

workouts.name: Aerobic Power 15:15 Wk1
workouts.description:
The intensity needs to be correct. You are aiming for ~70-80% of your max boulder grade. You should have an elevated heart rate and breathing will be elevated also. You want significant but controlled forearm pump, roughly 7-8/10 pump.
You should not be failing.
6-8 hand moves per 15second rep.

exercises.name: Aerobic Power 15:15
exercises.tips: 15secs on : 15secs off x 3mins continuously

workouts.name: Phase2 Wk5 Day1 SR
workouts.description: The emphasis on this phase is on power

exercises.name: Pull-up
exercises.tips: Be as explosive as possible, pull up with as much intent to move as fast as possible

exercises.name: SA Landmine Press
exercises.tips: Press as fast as possible, emphasis is on power - moving as explosively as possible

exercises.name: Explosive Step-up
exercises.tips: Punch 5kg / 10kg plate over head as you step up. Hold top position for 2secs

exercises.tips: Row with speed but with good posture

workouts.name: Phase 3 Wk9 Day1 SR
workouts.description: Max recruitment strength followed by high-quality Kilterboard power intervals. Stop a set if force or movement speed drops.

exercises.name: Half Crimp Block Lifts
exercises.tips: Maximum intent on every lift. Rest 3-4 minutes between sets.

exercises.name: Pull-up
exercises.tips: Accelerate through every rep. Rest 3 minutes between sets.

exercises.name: BB Floor Press (Chest Press)
exercises.tips: Use your current estimated 1RM, not an all-time best. Press explosively at RPE 7; stop the set if bar speed clearly drops.

exercises.name: RFE DB Split Squat
exercises.tips: Control the descent, then drive up explosively. Use total dumbbell load at RPE 7-8 and retain two to three reps in reserve.

exercises.name: Kilterboard Limit Power
exercises.tips: Climb for 10 seconds near limit grade. Use maximal-quality moves and step off before power fades.

workouts.name: Phase 3 Wk9 Day2 SR
workouts.description: Max-effort recruitment with low reps and complete recovery. Every working rep should be crisp.

exercises.name: Half Crimp RFD Hangs
exercises.tips: Pull into the edge as rapidly as possible. Rest 3 minutes between sets.

exercises.name: Pull-up
exercises.tips: Maximum acceleration from a dead hang. Rest 3 minutes between sets.

exercises.name: Chest Supported Row
exercises.tips: Row explosively without losing trunk position.

exercises.name: Side Plank Star w/ Band Pull Iso
exercises.tips: Maintain full-body tension without reaching fatigue.

exercises.name: RFE DB Split Squat

exercises.name: Kilterboard Limit Power

workouts.name: Phase 4 Wk13 Day1 SR
workouts.description: Peaking session: highest-quality recruitment with ultra-low volume and long recovery.

exercises.name: Half Crimp Block Lifts
exercises.tips: Only maximal-quality reps. Rest 4-5 minutes between sets.

exercises.name: Pull-up
exercises.tips: Explode from a dead hang and stop before velocity loss.

exercises.name: BB Floor Press (Chest Press)
exercises.tips: Use your current estimated 1RM. One fast maintenance set at RPE 8; do not grind or approach failure.

exercises.name: RFE DB Split Squat
exercises.tips: One crisp set using total dumbbell load. Drive up fast at RPE 8 and retain two reps in reserve.

exercises.name: Kilterboard Limit Attempts
exercises.tips: Use one to three maximal moves from a performance project. End each attempt while power is high.

workouts.name: Phase 4 Wk13 Day2 SR
workouts.description: Low-volume recruitment primer. Finish fresher than you started.

exercises.name: Half Crimp RFD Hangs
exercises.tips: Apply force instantly, then relax fully between efforts.

exercises.name: Pull-up
exercises.tips: Maximum acceleration; no grinding reps.

exercises.name: Chest Supported Row
exercises.tips: Fast, crisp maintenance work only.

workouts.name: Phase 4 Wk14 Day1 SR

exercises.tips: Only maximal-quality reps. Rest 4-5 minutes between sets.

exercises.name: Pull-up
exercises.tips: Explode from a dead hang and stop before velocity loss.

exercises.name: BB Floor Press (Chest Press)
exercises.tips: Use your current estimated 1RM. One fast maintenance set at RPE 7-8; avoid soreness and grinding.

exercises.name: RFE DB Split Squat
exercises.tips: One crisp set using total dumbbell load. Drive up fast at RPE 7-8 and retain two to three reps in reserve.

exercises.name: Kilterboard Limit Attempts
exercises.tips: Use one to three maximal moves from a performance project. End each attempt while power is high.

workouts.name: Phase 4 Wk14 Day2 SR

exercises.name: Half Crimp RFD Hangs
exercises.tips: Apply force instantly, then relax fully between efforts.

exercises.name: Pull-up

workouts.name: Phase 4 Wk15 Day1 Taper
workouts.description: Final taper: approximately 50% of prior-week volume while intensity stays high. Finish every effort fresh.

exercises.name: Half Crimp Block Lifts
exercises.tips: One maximal-quality recruitment rep only.

exercises.name: Pull-up
exercises.tips: One maximal-speed rep; no grinding.

exercises.name: BB Floor Press (Chest Press)
exercises.tips: Final primer using your current estimated 1RM. Move every rep fast at RPE 7 and stop well before fatigue.

exercises.name: RFE DB Split Squat
exercises.tips: Final primer using total dumbbell load. Drive up fast at RPE 7 and stop well before fatigue.

exercises.name: Kilterboard Power Primer
exercises.tips: Two brief maximal bursts on familiar moves. Stop well before fatigue.

workouts.name: Phase 4 Wk15 Day2 Taper
workouts.description: Final neural primer at half volume. Skip this session if performance day is within 48 hours.

exercises.name: Half Crimp RFD Hangs
exercises.tips: One rapid force effort only.

exercises.name: Pull-up
exercises.tips: One maximal-speed rep; no grinding.

exercises.name: Chest Supported Row
exercises.tips: One crisp maintenance set only.
